old: The Reform Diet of Pozsony (Bratislava) birthed modern Hungarian parliamentary debate. Count István Széchenyi championed patient economic modernization (*szerves fejlődés*), while Lajos Kossuth wielded thunderous popular rhetoric to achieve civic emancipation (*érdekegyesítés*).
new: The Reform Diets of Pozsony (Bratislava) were the main stage of political debate in the Reform Era (1825-1848). Count István Széchenyi stood for patient economic modernization (*szerves fejlődés*), while Lajos Kossuth argued for political freedom and for uniting the interests of nobles and the rest of the nation (*érdekegyesítés*).
why: "birthed modern parliamentary debate" overclaims; "thunderous ... emancipation" loose
